about: Math spans for LaTeX's own delimiters (mathdelimiters.ts): each case's math tokens in document order, as [type, content, markup, close] (a dollar token closes with its markup), with the parser's dollar math rules alongside (dollarmath.fixtures.json). \(...\) is inline math, \[...\] and the display environments are displayed math, as dollar math's tokens. A parser on the server, or a conversion of saved Markdown to the dollar form, must give the same spans. The last case comes from the tests of cscience-crypto, contributed under the MIT License by its author.
